conversation.configuration.prepare.authority: existing canonical scope and saved original manifest
conversation.configuration.prepare.result: bounded workspace and tool choices, original request, preparation digest; no permission granted

conversation.configure.authority: exact existing canonical entry and original owner, explicit full configuration confirmation
conversation.configure.request: frozen OpenConversation request and preparation/source/execution project/confirmation hash
conversation.configure.result: original canonical connection receipt only; UNKNOWN never replays POST

conversation.configuration.operation.result: matching original configuration receipt; saved candidate states may offer explicit same-owner continuation, query never starts or binds

conversation.configuration.continue.authority: original operation/request/confirmation and both logical and execution project grants
conversation.configuration.continue.result: matching original configuration receipt; unknown/processing/committed only observed

conversation.owner.prepare.authority: exact canonical scope and registered public original owner; logical and original execution project grants
conversation.owner.prepare.request: exact scope; selection uses frozen operation/source/expected previous selection; operation uses original hash/source
conversation.owner.prepare.result: bounded original owner metadata or exact original selection receipt

conversation.owner.select.authority: exact canonical scope and registered public original owner; logical and original execution project grants
conversation.owner.select.request: exact scope; selection uses frozen operation/source/expected previous selection; operation uses original hash/source
conversation.owner.select.result: bounded original owner metadata or exact original selection receipt

conversation.owner.operation.authority: exact canonical scope and registered public original owner; logical and original execution project grants
conversation.owner.operation.request: exact scope; selection uses frozen operation/source/expected previous selection; operation uses original hash/source
conversation.owner.operation.result: bounded original owner metadata or exact original selection receipt

conversation.configuration.adoption.prep.authority: exact original config key/native hash/confirmation plus current logical scope and all old/current/execution project grants
conversation.configuration.adoption.prep.request: original reference/current scope, immutable preparation/confirmation; operation reads original metadata key/hash
conversation.configuration.adoption.prep.result: exact adoption preparation or original acknowledgement receipt; original SDK request and grants unchanged

conversation.configuration.adoption.comm.authority: exact original config key/native hash/confirmation plus current logical scope and all old/current/execution project grants
conversation.configuration.adoption.comm.request: original reference/current scope, immutable preparation/confirmation; operation reads original metadata key/hash
conversation.configuration.adoption.comm.result: exact adoption preparation or original acknowledgement receipt; original SDK request and grants unchanged

conversation.configuration.adoption.oper.authority: exact original config key/native hash/confirmation plus current logical scope and all old/current/execution project grants
conversation.configuration.adoption.oper.request: original reference/current scope, immutable preparation/confirmation; operation reads original metadata key/hash
conversation.configuration.adoption.oper.result: exact adoption preparation or original acknowledgement receipt; original SDK request and grants unchanged
